source_title: Patricia Clarkson, Elizabeth Marvel, Felix Solis & Sean Astin Among Amazon’s ‘Everyone In My Family Has Killed Someone’ Cast
source_excerpt:
Prime Video has set 8 actors as series regulars in the upcoming dark comedy Everyone in My Family Has Killed Someone from David Hemingson ( The Holdovers , Kitchen Confidential ), based on the bestselling novel by Benjamin Stevenson. They include Patricia Clarkson , Elizabeth Marvel , Daniella Garcia, Felix Solis , Sean Astin , Annaleigh Ashford , Chris Walley, and Eliza Bennett.
Everyone in My Family Has Killed Someone is set deep in the dense mountains of Vermont’s Northeast Kingdom and follows Ern Cunningham (Penn Badgley), a mystery-writing expert who reluctantly attends a family reunion to welcome his brother Michael home from prison — the same brother Ern helped convict. When a frozen body appears, and a snowstorm traps everyone inside, the deaths begin to mount. Everyone in his family has already killed someone – either by accident or otherwise. The following character names and descriptions for some of the new cast, reported by sources, can be found below. Watch on Deadline
Clarkson will play Audrey, a widowed mother turned pariah.
Solis will play Marcelo, Audrey’s second husband.
Garcia will play Dr. Sofia Garcia, Marcelo’s daughter with a secret.
Marvel will play Katherine, Audrey’s sister.
Astin will play Andy, Katherine’s husband.
Executive producers include David Hemingson; Bruna Papandrea, Steve Hutensky, and Jeanne Snow via Made Up Stories; Molly Allen; Badgley; Alexandra Brodski, who will direct half of the episodes, including the pilot and season finale; and Stevenson. Everyone in My Family Has Killed Someone is produced by Amazon MGM Studios, Fifth Season, and Made Up Stories.
Clarkson is repped by CAA and Entertainment 360. Marvel is repped by Verve, Viking Entertainment, and Franklin, Weinrib, Rudell + Vassallo LLP. Garcia is repped by Linden Entertainment and Realm Talent. Solis is repped by D2 Management. Astin is repped by Stewart Talent, Luber / Roklin, and Brecheen, Feldman, Breimer, Silver, Thompson. Ashford is repped by CAA and Beth Rosner Management. Walley is repped by Curtis Brown and Canopy Media Partners. Bennett is repped by Affirmative Entertainment and The Artist’s Partnership.
